name: install_version
title: Install specific version of a package.

origin.description: Install one source version from a CRAN-like repository, including the archive when the current tree does not have it.
origin.usage: install_version(package, version = NULL, dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), quiet = FALSE, build = FALSE, repos = getOption("repos"), type = "source", ...)

arguments.name: package
arguments.text: One package name. Several names are an error. An empty name returns NULL.

arguments.name: version
arguments.text: The version to install, compared with the available and archived versions.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The tarball is installed with install_url. RemoteType, RemoteUrl, and RemoteSubdir are then removed from the installed DESCRIPTION.
origin.example: install_version("minipkg", "0.0.1", repos = repos, type = "source", dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Install one source version from a CRAN-like repository.
translation.usage: install_version(package, version=None, dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', quiet=False, build=False, repos=None, type='source', lib=None)

arguments.text: Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The current contriburl is searched first. archive.rds is read with Rscript only when the current tree does not contain the version. After install, the url remote fields are dropped.
translation.value: The list returned by install_url, usually one package name.
translation.example: install_version("minipkg", "0.0.1", repos=repos, type="source", dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, lib=lib)
